digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 and batch runner usage threading
propositions: Pass-1 and prerequisite finder discard per-call LLM usage; token totals are not persisted to batch output, blocking coverage metrics and per-criterion request accounting

Usage must be threaded as return-value pairs through the entire call chain (passes, sizing, runner) from all entry points (pass1, prerequisites, evals, criterion preview) with coordinated signature changes

Multi-criterion single-turn chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting llm_calls and requests in full per criterion; ladder-retry attempts each contribute a separate call record

The sidecar payload must carry raw per-call usage records and per-criterion derived maps under coverage.usage.per_call and coverage.usage.per_criterion; checkpoint-served chunks and raising attempts contribute no usage
Extended _attach_plan_review_metrics must fold per-call token totals into coverage.metrics alongside existing timing fields
